sloka: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसैरर्दिता भृशम्।दिशो दश द्रुताः केचित् केचित् सुग्रीवमाश्रिताः ।। ६.९८.१० ।।
transliteration: tataste vānarāḥ sarve rākṣasairarditā bhṛśam।diśo daśa drutāḥ kecit kecit sugrīvamāśritāḥ ।। 6.98.10 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, unable to bear the pain, those Vanaras hit by Rakshasas, went in ten directions and some went to Sugriva for refuge.
